title: Per-session actor identity
body: Every command defaults the actor to git user.name, so two agent sessions on one machine are both the same actor. Leases only protect against a different actor, so two of the user's own sessions can claim the same issue and neither is refused; the claim machinery is decorative for one user running parallel sessions. Fix: a per-session actor. The SessionStart hook receives a session id on stdin, so prime could tell the agent what --actor to pass, or foam could read one from an environment variable the harness sets. Needs a look at what Claude Code exposes.
